title: The Influence of Humic Substances on Microbially Induced Vivianite Crystallization
description: Phosphorus recovery from wastewater via microbially induced vivianite crystallization is a promising approach. This project aims to investigate the effects of humic substances in wastewater on the efficiency of microbially induced vivianite crystallization and the structure of microbial communities. The study involved adding different concentrations of soluble humic substances (humic acid, fulvic acid) and insoluble humic substances (humin) during the phosphorus recovery process. The results demonstrated that humic substances can enhance the abundance of dissimilatory iron-reducing bacteria to varying degrees while reducing the abundance of non-dissimilatory iron-reducing microorganisms, such as methanogenic archaea.
